# [pixi](../../index.md) [workspace](../index.md) [preview](index.md) remove

Remove preview feature(s) from the workspace

--8<-- "docs/reference/cli/pixi/workspace/preview/remove_extender:description"

## Usage
```
pixi workspace preview remove <FEATURE>...
```

## Arguments
- <a id="arg-FEATURE" href="#arg-FEATURE">`<FEATURE>`</a>
:  The preview feature(s) to add or remove, e.g. `pixi-build`
<br>May be provided more than once.
<br>**required**: `true`

## Description
Remove preview feature(s) from the workspace.

Example: `pixi workspace preview remove pixi-build`
